title: Dynamic diagram for rustinfer: build, then the first run
intro: What happens between `rustinfer build` and the first token, numbered in order across containers and components. Each step's chip is its component's state; the steps whose code is not written yet are the Release 1 issues still open.

steps.what: reads config.json, every shard header and the weight byte ranges it uses (a checkpoint's KV scales); picks the Architecture; emits Model IR, the weight manifest and the checkpoint identity
validates the Model IR document: shapes, dtypes, encodings, operator arity
runs the pass pipeline to a Plan under the profile; the planner places it on the discovered devices
asks for each kernel by KernelQuery; generators build Kernel IR, tuned entries come from the catalog
lowers Kernel IR to ROCDL and links an AMDGPU code object per kernel
writes the Plan, the kernels and the manifest; hashes last; fsync and rename into the cache
reads and verifies magic, bounds, hash, target and the checkpoint identity; any failure refuses the load
streams the used byte ranges of the checkpoint into device memory, transforming the layout on the way
loads the code objects, launches the Plan, samples a token
prints the tokens; a client of the library awaits the same responses

build.title: Build: rustinfer build
build.lede: From the checkpoint to a verified artifact in the cache; nothing here needs a GPU.

run.title: First run: rustinfer run
run.lede: From the artifact to the first token: verify, stream the weights, launch.
